about: Own-words reads from the daily research task (ADMIS, Rabobank, Czapp and the news feed). fund_score: -1 bearish to +1 bullish, a judgement on the fundamental news only.

corn.fundamental: Nothing new on supply or demand; Dec drifted back toward the 434 support area with no fresh buying, and the broader risk-off tone does not help. The model view slipped to strongly bearish on price action.
events: Corn slips lower on Friday (Barchart)
Brazil corn-ethanol growth trims export competition (news flow)

soybeans.fundamental: Beans and especially meal rallied despite the reports that China is holding imported beans at ports; meal is leading, which points to product demand rather than a change in Chinese buying. South American planting is now past halfway, so the weather window is the next driver.
events: Soybeans rally with meal leading (Barchart)
South American planting passes halfway (ADMIS)

meal.fundamental: Meal led the soy complex up nearly 3% on Friday, pushing Dec toward 342 resistance; with soyoil weak on the palm news, the crush mix is shifting value toward meal.
events: Meal leads soybeans higher (Barchart)
China halts palm buying, weighing on veg oils (Bloomberg)

oil.fundamental: A new bearish demand signal from the veg-oil complex: China has halted palm oil purchases because storage is full, adding to the soft tone in soyoil alongside weak crude.
events: China halts palm oil buying as storage fills (Bloomberg)
Soyoil broke support midweek (Barchart)

wheat.fundamental: A longer-run supportive item: India's wheat area is on course for the biggest drop in 26 years as farmers switch crops, which could reduce one large exporter-competitor's surplus. US demand is still slow, so the bounce is technical for now.
events: India's wheat sowing set for steepest fall in 26 years (Reuters)
US wheat export sales rise (MarketWatch)
Oversold support despite slow demand (Brownfield)

kc.fundamental: Same read as Chicago: India's likely smaller wheat area is a medium-term positive for world prices, while HRW demand remains sluggish.
events: India's wheat sowing set for steepest fall in 26 years (Reuters)
Wheat rallies back Thursday (Barchart)

cotton.fundamental: Still no fresh supply news; mixed US yields and a demand-negative risk-off day in equities. Focus stays on old-crop Dec/Mar/May/Jul; Dec delivery near 75-76, and high-grade certs are a risk for longs. The tile has eased to neutral.
events: Mixed US cotton yields after weather extremes (Farm Progress)
AI-led equity rout, VIX near 35 (AP)

hogs.fundamental: Hogs fell back toward contract lows into the holiday week; there is nothing new on supply, and the Thailand market access remains too small to matter near term.
events: Hogs fall back on Friday (Barchart)
Thailand opens to US pork (Bloomberg)

cattle.fundamental: Today's Cattle on Feed report (2pm CT) was expected to show record-low October placements and marketings, which would confirm tight fed supply. A new risk: New World screwworm cases are rising in the US, which keeps the Mexican feeder import border question and herd-health worries alive.
events: COF expected to show record-low placements and marketings (Pro Farmer)
Screwworm cases surge in the US (Reuters)
Futures trade mixed ahead of USDA report (Barchart)

feeders.fundamental: Same driver as live cattle: the Cattle on Feed placements number sets the read on the feeder pipeline, and rising US screwworm cases make a reopening of Mexican feeder imports less likely, which is supportive for feeders.
events: Screwworm cases surge in the US (Reuters)
COF expected to show record-low placements (Pro Farmer)

class3.fundamental: Cheese blocks fell again at the CME spot session, the main pressure on Class III; there is no supply-side news.
events: Cheese blocks drop, NDM rises at CME spot (Brownfield)

class4.fundamental: Nonfat dry milk rose at the CME spot session, a modest support for Class IV; butter was little changed.
events: NDM increases at CME spot (Brownfield)

palm.fundamental: Clearly bearish demand news: China has stopped buying palm oil because its storage is full, removing a major buyer just as prices slide.
events: China halts palm oil purchases as storage runs out (Bloomberg)

natgas.fundamental: Natgas bounced about 4% on the weather pattern; the longer-run LNG export build-out (Sabine Pass expansion approved) remains supportive. The tile has eased from bearish to mildly bearish.
events: Natgas rebounds on weather (Yahoo Finance)
FERC approves Sabine Pass LNG expansion (news flow)

crude.fundamental: Two-way risk: reports of Iranian attacks on tankers near Hormuz and renewed Houthi activity add supply risk, but strong Middle East export flows and a faster US rig count kept crude on course for a third weekly loss. The equity rout is a demand-sentiment negative.
events: Iran steps up Hormuz tanker attacks (OilPrice.com)
US drillers add rigs as prices fall (OilPrice.com)
Oil set for third weekly drop on strong Mideast flows (Reuters)

ulsd.fundamental: Diesel gave back part of its Red Sea premium today; shipping-route risk from the Houthis and Hormuz tanker attacks is still the main support for distillate cracks.
events: Hormuz tanker attacks (OilPrice.com)
Houthi attacks revive product-shipping risk (OilPrice.com)
